newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MALDINI MAKES FEW CHANGES IN FIRST ITALY SIDE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MALDINI MAKES FEW CHANGES IN FIRST ITALY SIDE.

text.p: Cesare Maldini took no risks when he named his first squad as Italy's national coach on Saturday -- he called up the main players in predecessor Arrigo Sacchi's side.

Former under-21 coach Maldini, appointed to the senior position last month when the unpopular Sacchi resigned to take the helm at AC Milan, called up 20 players for the friendly against Northern Ireland in Palermo next Wednesday.

Maldini, whose junior side won the last three European championships, called up two stalwarts of his last under-21 team -- Internazionale midfielder Salvatore Fresi and Parma defender Fabio Cannavaro. Both are uncapped at senior level.

The only other changes were the return of Parma right back Antonio Benarrivo, who replaces Juventus's Moreno Torricelli, and Milan midfielder Stefano Eranio, who fills the gap left by veteran Roberto Donadoni.

Maldini, who plays a more defensive brand of football than Sacchi, has promised significant tactical changes but had said he would not take any risks for the Palermo match and would stick with most of Sacchi's players.

Maldini, whose son Paolo will remain as captain, was expected to make more changes for Italy's key World Cup qualifier against England in London on February 12, for which he will have more time to prepare.

In Palermo, Chelsea striker Gianfranco Zola is likely to start up front alongside Lazio's Pierluigi Casiraghi, with Middlesbrough's Fabrizio Ravanelli and Juve's Alessandro Del Piero coming on later in the match.
Squad: Goalkeepers: Angelo Peruzzi, Francesco Toldo.

Defenders: Ciro Ferrara, Alessandro Costacurta, Alessandro Nesta, Fabio Cannavaro, Paolo Maldini, Antonio Benarrivo. Midfielders: Salvatore Fresi, Angelo Di Livio, Stefano Eranio, Roberto Di Matteo, Demetrio Albertini, Dino Baggio, Diego Fuser, Amedeo Carboni. Forwards: Pierluigi Casiraghi, Fabrizio Ravanelli, Gianfranco Zola, Alessandro Del Piero.
